title: Chicken with noodles and cheese sauce, diet frozen meal

content.title: About
content.content: Chicken with noodles and cheese sauce is a diet frozen meal designed for quick and convenient preparation. It contains lean chicken breast, whole‑grain noodles, and a creamy low‑fat cheese sauce. The product is aimed at people who watch their calorie intake but do not want to sacrifice flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The meal can be ready in 3–5 minutes using a microwave or stovetop.
The cheese sauce is low in saturated fat while retaining a smooth texture.
Chicken breast undergoes double thermal processing to ensure safety.
Noodles are made from whole‑grain flour, increasing fiber content.
One serving provides approximately 250 kcal, fitting many diet plans.

items.title: High‑quality protein
items.content: Chicken breast supplies complete protein essential for maintaining muscle mass.

items.title: Low fat content
items.content: Reduced fat in the sauce helps control calorie intake and supports healthy cholesterol levels.

items.title: Fiber from whole‑grain noodles
items.content: Whole‑grain noodles aid digestion and promote satiety.

items.title: Calcium from cheese sauce
items.content: Despite being low‑fat, the sauce retains calcium important for bone health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Chicken and whole‑grain noodles provide vitamins B6 and B12, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: The cheese sauce may trigger reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or milk allergy.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Monitor overall daily salt intake to avoid elevated blood pressure.

items.title: Complete heating required
items.content: Insufficiently heated meals may contain live bacteria; heat to an internal temperature of at least 75 °C.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the frozen meal in a microwave or on the stovetop, stirring thoroughly to distribute the sauce evenly. Serve hot; optionally add fresh vegetables or herbs to increase volume and nutrients.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the product frozen at –18 °C or lower. Once thawed, consume within 24 hours and do not refreeze. Discard if any off‑odor or discoloration appears.
